shared_elements: repeated vertical strokes in a row
incised linear marks on a wall-like surface
justification: Both surfaces carry incised registers with horizontal dividing lines, small circles and zigzag/chevron elements, and rows of repeated vertical strokes, but these are near-universal graphic devices. A shows a figural programme (animals in profile, quadrupeds, a bird with long neck, a possible anthropomorph with raised arms) rendered in modelled relief, while B is entirely non-figural, consisting of thin linear scratched geometric signs and lattice crosshatching.
